Each trap has a weight in kg. Your bag has a maximum weight limit that increases as you level up.

• Light traps can be carried in large numbers.
• Heavy traps are fewer but more powerful.
• When the bag is full by weight, you must wait for traps to be used before carrying more.

Your current weight limit is shown in the bar at the top of the bag.
A harmless prank that makes the captor laugh out loud for a moment. Lightweight and easy to carry!
Freezes the captured player for 60 seconds. Plan your routes carefully around active traps!
A powerful trap that freezes the captured player for 5 full minutes! Hard to place but devastating when triggered.

The real-world trap game where you place hidden traps on a live map and catch other players — right in your neighbourhood.
Trapp uses your real GPS location — go outside for the full experience!
You start with a set of traps in your bag. Each trap type has different effects, placement times, and recharge cycles.\n\nOpen the Trap Bag at the bottom of the map to see what you\'re carrying.
Traps recharge automatically over time — check back if your bag is low.

1. Tap a spot on the map near you.
2. Pick a trap from your bag.
3. Walk to the chosen location.
4. Hold the PUSH button until placement completes.

Your trap is now live and invisible to others!
You must be within 20 m of the placement point. Pick a clever hiding spot!
When another player walks into the radius of your active trap, they get caught automatically.\n\nYou earn XP, their daily trap quota is reduced, and you climb the leaderboard.
You can see your own active traps on the map — others can\'t!
Other players are setting traps for you too!\n\nIf you spot a trap marker on the map, walk close and hold the DISARM button to neutralise it before it catches you.
Being caught reduces your daily traps available. Stay alert!
Add friends, form Ally Groups, and coordinate your trapping strategy.\n\nCheck the leaderboard to see who\'s on top — then go out and beat them.
Each day is a fresh start. Traps reset, scores accumulate. Good luck!
